validation.title: Give the task a title.
validation.brief: Describe what the agent should achieve.
validation.projectPath: The agent project must be an absolute path.

allTasks.title: All agent tasks
allTasks.description: Every project's tasks. New tasks start in a project's Agent tasks tab.

panel.title: Agent tasks
panel.description: Work that takes days. Each task wakes its agent when something happens; the card is its memory.
panel.trustDescription: On: a task an agent creates works within its mandate right away (messages go out as the account allows). Off: you confirm the mandate first and its messages wait as drafts.
panel.emptyHint: Create one here, or tell an agent in a chat — e.g. “find a printer for our labels, ask for prices and recommend one”. It sets up the task, mails suppliers when you allow it, and wakes up whenever someone replies.
panel.hideOlder: Hide tasks closed over 30 days ago

board.markAllReadDescription: Clears the badges. Questions, mandates and drafts still wait for you.
board.confirmDelete_one: Delete this task? A running agent stops and unsent drafts are discarded. This cannot be undone.
board.confirmDelete_other: Delete {{count}} tasks? A running agent stops and unsent drafts are discarded. This cannot be undone.

card.nextCheckTitle: The agent looks again at this time

form.editIntro: The agent sees your changes on its next wake-up; changing the brief or mandate wakes it now.
form.newIntro: For work that takes days. The agent works step by step, keeps the card up to date and asks you when it needs a decision.
form.title: Title
form.briefHint: Goal, what done looks like, deadlines and anything it must know.
form.briefPlaceholder: Find a printer for our 50×30 mm labels (matte, 4 designs), get prices for 1 000 and 5 000 pcs incl. delivery, compare them and recommend one.
form.mandate: What may it do on its own?
form.mandateHint: The mandate. Anything outside it, the agent asks you first. Orders and payments always need you.
form.mandatePlaceholder: e.g. May e-mail up to 8 Czech printers asking for a quote and answer their questions. Must not order, pay or promise anything.
form.agentProjectHint: The project whose agent runs the task — its AGENTS.md, subagents and MCP servers.
form.autonomousNote: Runs are autonomous: nobody sits at the chat to approve tool calls. What the agent may do is set by the mandate above.

detail.confirmClose: Mark #{{id}} as {{status}}? The agent stops and unsent drafts are discarded.
detail.confirmCloseRunning: Mark #{{id}} as {{status}}? The agent stops (its current run too) and unsent drafts are discarded.
detail.confirmDelete: Delete task #{{id}} “{{title}}” with its diary? Unsent drafts are discarded.

detail.answerNoteLabel: Add a note to your choice, or answer in your own words
detail.confirmMandateExplain: An agent created this task. Until you confirm what it may do on its own, every message it writes waits here as a draft.
detail.noMandate: (no mandate — it may not contact anyone)
detail.firstStep: The agent is on its first step…
detail.noSummary: The agent has not written a summary yet.
detail.mayOnItsOwn: The agent may on its own
detail.mayOnItsOwnUnconfirmed: The agent may on its own (not confirmed yet)
detail.commentPlaceholder: Message the agent — e.g. “prefer printers in Brno” (wakes it up)
detail.closedHint: Closed — move it back to Working to wake the agent.
